title: —PAX SUPER TOTUM SANGUINARIUM GLOBUM
html_source:
Latin,
Peace over the whole bloody world.

Cranly tries to break the argument between Stephen and MacCann with interjecting here — Notice the narration does not say anything of how no one heeded Cranly’s words as they would have for Temple if he had interjected, such as “No heed was paid to his words.”
